## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with jet-black tresses and curls, a black head, and black eyes inherited from her mother. She features rosy, crimson cheeks and dimples, along with a merry, bright-eyed expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Personality

Diana is a smart, good, and practical individual who possesses a merry expression and a ladylike demeanor. She displays an unselfish admiration for her friends' talents and is known for her musical ability in singing solos. Additionally, she has earned a reputation for her notable taste in dressing, making her advice on the subject highly sought after.

## History

Diana Barry was named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family at the time of her birth. As a child living at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), she formed an instant, deep bond with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), and the pair pledged to be bosom friends forever. Their close friendship faced early trials when Diana's mother temporarily forbade them from playing together, but Diana secretly exchanged notes with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) until the restriction was lifted. Together with their friends, Diana helped form a story club and later joined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in canvassing for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Over the years, she accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on numerous outings, including a walk where they discovered [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and met Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), as well as a search for a replacement willow-ware platter. Diana was eventually engaged to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), a development that led [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on her own future romantic dreams. Diana served as a bridesmaid for Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and later hosted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for visits during college breaks, including an occasion where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) read her early manuscript drafts to Diana for feedback. Diana eventually married [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) assisting in her wedding preparations. After settling into married life, Diana gave birth to a newborn baby boy.

## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> "I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) become instant, devoted bosom friends after meeting at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), swearing a solemn oath of eternal friendship. Over the years, they share countless milestones, including attending school, rowing on the pond, forming a story club, and standing by each other through childhood illness and emergency. Their deep bond persists through periods of enforced separation and physical distance as their lives evolve.
